Folks — thanks for taking the interview with Priya today. Quick request: please add a short bullet-pointed debrief to Greenhouse and drop your top 2 signal strengths + any concerns in the Slack thread #hiring-backend. I’m attaching a debrief template to keep responses consistent (interviewer-debrief-template.docx).

- Candidate summary (one line)
- Strengths observed (2 bullets)
- Concerns / unknowns (1–2 bullets)
- Hire recommendation (yes/maybe/no)

If you can post this by EOD Mon Apr 13 that helps us move quickly.

Thanks — Neha
